name: wmkf_potentialreviewers-identity-binding
_comment: Additive identity-binding durability for the reviewer holistic redesign. These columns are deliberately non-authoritative at schema delivery: null means legacy/unbound, and current runtime readers/writers continue to use the legacy identity fields until a later owner-approved dual-write/read cutover. IdentityFieldLineageJson is a compact server-owned map for the small identity-bearing field set; it is not a duplicate of IdentityVerifiedAnchorsJson evidence.

attributes.description: Monotonic generation of the current bound-person identity. Null means legacy/unbound. Starts at 1; advances only for a material binding transition.

Server-owned provenance for the current binding: self_reported | staff_confirmed | automated | legacy_unbound. Null is also treated as legacy/unbound during migration. Resolver confidence is not a binding source.
Canonical server-normalized anchor for the currently bound person, such as an ORCID or OpenAlex canonical key. Null means no durable binding has been established.
Timestamp when the current identity binding generation was established or explicitly attested.
Binding generation from which the current resolver-derived identity bundle was produced. Null or a mismatch with IdentityBindingVersion means the derived bundle is stale.

Compact server-owned map from each mutable identity-bearing field to its source and binding generation. Enables replacement to clear superseded derived values without erasing independently attested/manual values. Not identity evidence; evidence remains in IdentityEvidenceSummary and IdentityVerifiedAnchorsJson.
